display_policy.scope: Both language homepages: selected rows, ranked merged-work tables and standalone adopted-work paragraphs. Own software projects and full contribution records are not filtered.
display_policy.aggregate_counters: All verified merged author PRs and their upstream repositories, including projects omitted from the homepage lists. Separately adopted work is excluded from these counters.
display_policy.top30_counter_scope: The homepage top-30 table and merged-project counter cover projects with directly merged PRs. Adopted-only TD-MPC2 remains in the existing adoption section, with its independently verified rank.
display_policy.timestamp_policy: Display update and observation dates without hours or minutes in both READMEs, current documentation and statistics graphics. Retain exact source observation timestamps in machine-readable evidence and preserve immutable historical archives.

search.partitioning: Three disjoint creation-date partitions: created:<2026-11-10 (605), created:2026-11-10..2026-11-13 (810), and created:>=2026-11-14 (178). All 18 pages read, deduplicated by canonical PR URL.

pr.title: Preserve target Q history and evaluation mode during conversion
pr.author: Afloat16

adopted_commit.author: Afloat16
adopted_commit.message:
Preserve target Q history and evaluation mode during conversion

WorldModel.to() calls init(), which recreated the target Q parameters
from the online ensemble (discarding Polyak/checkpoint history) and
rebuilt the target module in whatever train/eval mode the online
ensemble was in. Initialize the target parameters only once and keep
the target module in eval mode after every rebuild.

Cherry-picked from #98 (implementation only; tests omitted).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

files.patch:
@@ -38,7 +38,8 @@ def __init__(self, cfg):
 	def init(self):
 		# Create params
 		self._detach_Qs_params = TensorDictParams(self._Qs.params.data, no_convert=True)
-		self._target_Qs_params = TensorDictParams(self._Qs.params.data.clone(), no_convert=True)
+		if not hasattr(self, "_target_Qs_params"):
+			self._target_Qs_params = TensorDictParams(self._Qs.params.data.clone(), no_convert=True)
 
 		# Create modules
 		with self._detach_Qs_params.data.to("meta").to_module(self._Qs.module):
@@ -51,6 +52,7 @@ def init(self):
 		self._detach_Qs.__dict__["params"] = self._detach_Qs_params
 		delattr(self._target_Qs, "params")
 		self._target_Qs.__dict__["params"] = self._target_Qs_params
+		self._target_Qs.train(False)
 
 	def __repr__(self):
 		repr = 'TD-MPC2 World Model\n'

other_accepted.maintainer_pr_description:
Supersedes #1140, #1141, #1142, #1143, #1144, #1145 and #1146 by @Afloat16. Each one edits `docs/ROADMAP.md` and `docs/STATUS.md`, so merging them one at a time would have left each later one in conflict. They're merged together here with the author's commits kept.

- #1140: inline source-map data URLs ignore their fragment, and the scheme and `base64` marker are matched case-insensitively.
- #1141: ZIP directories are recognised from DOS and Unix attributes even without a trailing slash.
- #1142: rejected ASAR names count toward the listing limit.
- #1143: a HAR with a UTF-8 BOM parses.
- #1144: a .NET bundle member can't read into the manifest's bytes.
- #1145: Play can start a Python project's one installed `[project.scripts]` console script from its own environment.
- #1146: Godot and Electron get an absolute project path.

Two fixes on top of the merge:
- #1145 and #1146 each edited the New-project toolchains row in STATUS. It's now one row carrying both additions, not two copies.
- #1146's `launch_tests` module is moved to the end of `outputs.rs`. On Windows an item after it made clippy fail with `items_after_test_module`, which the Linux gate doesn't compile.

**Verified:** the `formats` and `engine` tests (552 in the engine library), clippy for both on Windows, fmt, `cargo xtask wasm` and layers pass on the merged result.

maintainer_acknowledgment.author: danyaberezun
maintainer_acknowledgment.body: Thanks @Afloat16 — the literal-filename fix landed as part of #1137, credited to you as co-author. #1137 rewrote the same `ignoredPaths` function (a fast `--no-index` first pass), so we folded your fix in there rather than merge two competing versions: the first pass reads `./<path>` records from `--stdin -z`, and the index pass keeps arguments (one index scan per batch — `--stdin` rescans the index per path, ~3× slower on large repos) and unquotes git's C-quoted names, so `"`, `\`, control characters and pathspec-looking names stay literal. Your tests for those names came along. Closing this in favour of #1137.

other_accepted.limitations: The final implementation differs from the source PR: the no-index pass uses NUL-delimited stdin, while the index pass uses bounded arguments and C-quoted path decoding. The entire watcher optimization and its performance results are not attributed to Afloat16. No tests were rerun.

pr.title: [PR] chore(branch): land 40 single-purpose fixes as one history-preserving batch (wave 5)
pr.author: ranxianglei
pr.body:
## What

One history-preserving batch landing Afloat16's 40 open single-purpose fix branches (each was a 1-commit PR with its own hermetic test). Each branch is pulled in as a real merge commit — original authors, commit messages, and history stay intact; no squashing, no cherry-pick rewrites.

Merge order follows the review sequence; the one textual conflict (`scripts/live-files.mjs`, two adjacent live-file registrations) is resolved as the union of both entries.

## Contents (branch → issue)

| Branch | Issue | One-line |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-12_apig-canonical-query (#6484) | #6483 | APiG canonical query normalization |
| 2026-11-12_bounded-log-window (#6487) | #6486 | bounded log read window |
| 2026-11-12_async-zstd-decode (#6489) | #6488 | async zstd decode (no sync decompress on hot path) |
| 2026-11-12_reconcile-long-history (#6492) | #6490 | gap-bracket reconcile for 150K-msg histories + spread-arg fix |
| 2026-11-12_search-unicode-offsets (#6494) | #6493 | unicode-safe lowercase-span → original offsets |
| 2026-11-12_cache-diff-byte-offsets (#6496) | #6495 | byte→UTF-16 offset mapping in wire diff |
| 2026-11-12_foreign-sweep-failure-exit (#6498) | #6497 | sweep exits 1 when foreign blocks fail |
| 2026-11-12_drop-fields-own-paths (#6500) | #6499 | hasOwn on compat-drop walks |
| 2026-11-12_inline-null-response-bodies (#6502) | #6501 | null body for HEAD/204/205/304 |
| 2026-11-12_inline-request-abort-signal (#6504) | #6503 | dispatcher falls back to Request input signal |
| 2026-11-13_inline-body-cancel (#6556) | #6555 | signal propagation through Request rebuilds |
| 2026-11-13_pi-inline-abort (#6560) | #6558 | rethrow AbortError before direct fallback |
| 2026-11-13_inline-request-init (#6563) | #6562 | standard Fetch signal-strip semantics in toInlineReq |
| 2026-11-13_pi-inline-fallback (#6566) | #6565 | fallback rebuilds Request, no double FormData |
| 2026-11-13_inline-stream-cancel (#6571) | #6570 | InlineRes bodyStream cancel destroys socket |
| 2026-11-13_inline-signal-cleanup (#6575) | #6573 | detach listeners on finish/close |
| 2026-11-13_proxy-connect-close (#6577) | #6576 | CONNECT error before headers, no 10s wait |
| 2026-11-13_linear-terminal-sse (#6579) | #6578 | O(n) terminal SSE parse, no whole-buffer concat |
| 2026-11-13_tool-content-order (#6581) | #6580 | capToolOutput keeps original part order |
| 2026-11-13_proxy-ca-trust (#6583) | #6582 | undici requestTls/proxyTls CA wiring |
| 2026-11-13_inline-data-billing (#6585) | #6584 | snake_case inline_data billing |
| 2026-11-13_bounded-message-previews (#6593) | #6590 | O(110) session preview walk |
| 2026-11-13_proxy-connect-buffered-data (#6595) | #6594 | paused-mode CONNECT reply read, no byte loss |
| 2026-11-13_lazy-message-stringify (#6597) | #6596 | JSON.stringify only when echo predicate matches |
| 2026-11-13_fastpath-json-grammar (#6599) | #6598 | strict JSON grammar in fastpath scan |
| 2026-11-13_multiline-sse-rewrite (#6603) | #6600 | multi-data: SSE frame join before rewrite |
| 2026-11-13_reactivation-linear (#6604) | #6601 | linear reactivation |
| 2026-11-13_egress-header-isolation (#6606) | #6605 | case-insensitive delete before header set |
| 2026-11-13_egress-header-replacement (#6608) | #6607 | draft headers committed only on plugin success |
| 2026-11-13_session-gc-companion-index (#6611) | #6609 | reversed-string binary-search companion lookup |
| 2026-11-13_lazy-messages-by-id (#6612) | #6610 | messagesById built only when needed |
| 2026-11-13_session-identity-query (#6615) | #6613 | point SELECT for session removal identity |
| 2026-11-13_block-content-join (#6618) | #6616 | block content materialized only for requested ids |
| 2026-11-13_loop-multiline-sse (#6619) | #6614 | shared sseEventData/replaceSseEventData across adapters |
| 2026-11-13_cleanup-accounting (#6622) | #6620 | cleanup accounting |
| 2026-11-13_gemini-complete-frame (#6623) | #6621 | one wire frame per chunk, non-call parts kept |
| 2026-11-13_count-active-blocks (#6626) | #6624 | SQL COUNT(*) instead of full block decode |
| 2026-11-13_commandcode-proxy-tools (#6627) | #6625 | ACP tool receipts hidden from CommandCode wire |
| 2026-11-13_loop-stream-cleanup (#6630) | #6628 | cancel upstream on in-band parse error + compress finally |
| 2026-11-13_google-stream-errors (#6631) | #6629 | in-band google error frames become terminal events |

## Verification

- All 40 branches reviewed line-by-line before batching (all kept, all with hermetic `node:test` coverage).
- Per-PR added-line audit: every line added by each PR is present in this branch (40/40 clean).
- `tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- All 40 added test suites + the #5403/#5418 watermark suite, run locally on node 22.23.4 with the exact CI preload set: 376/376 pass.

Closes #6483 #6486 #6488 #6490 #6493 #6495 #6497 #6499 #6501 #6503 #6555 #6558 #6562 #6565 #6570 #6573 #6576 #6578 #6580 #6582 #6584 #6590 #6594 #6596 #6598 #6600 #6601 #6605 #6607 #6609 #6610 #6613 #6616 #6614 #6620 #6621 #6624 #6625 #6628 #6629

pr.title: [PR] fix: retain reconciliation brackets for very long histories
pr.author: Afloat16
pr.body:
Closes #6490

## Problem

A long session can fail reconciliation even when almost all re-minted message IDs have verified positional matches. The gap-resolution pass expands every claimed index into Math.min/Math.max arguments; 150,000 claims exceed the JavaScript engine's argument limit and throw RangeError before the folded history is reconciled.

## Change

Maintain the smallest and largest verified indices as the head and tail scans claim positions. This removes both the unbounded argument list and the temporary claimed-index array. Existing fingerprint, role, length, content and no-evidence rules are unchanged; an unbracketed gap remains unmatched.

## Initial validation

- Independent base: 9674cfafbc78c50245ae0d887483d3d6ce880c15.
- Unmodified source: the new 150,001-message regression fails with RangeError at Math.min(...claimedIdx); three controls pass.
- Fixed source: 117 tests pass across fold-reconcile-large-history, fold-reconcile, issue2915-order-centric-reconcile, fold-reconcile-positional and fold-reconcile-perf.
- The new cases exercise a verified middle gap, gaps outside both ends of a bracket, no verified claims, and a 150,001-message unchanged-history fast path. Existing cases cover resync, tail/head shifts, re-keying and evidence gates.
- npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run check:unused-exports, npm run check:test-import-graph and git diff --check pass.
- Tests run on Linux x64 / Node 24.22.1. Zero-token Codex preflight finds codex-cli 0.167.0-alpha.4 and the built artifact; its local upstream /models probe is unreachable. The real-model suite remains gated/skipped, and full upstream CI was not verified by these initial local checks.

## Prior work and tracking

Checked all 61 Afloat16 PRs, all 160 fork branches, the full fold-reconcile history and upstream issue/PR searches for claimedIdx, reconciliation/argument limits and call-stack failures. #6246 fixes plugin-render's fold-anchor placement, a separate endpoint; it does not cover this reconciliation pass.

## Earlier master integration

Merged upstream master `fcc2e848486cc2152e36b6658c517fbfa51ec428` into this branch without textual conflicts. The published merge commit is [`2f2fe73d838f312f29e0c28db99b1dc795d86fd6`](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/commit/2f2fe73d838f312f29e0c28db99b1dc795d86fd6), with the original PR head `a731d247dce8d2a84dea844ff330287069d3c87a` as its first parent and that master commit as its second parent.

The reconciliation fix and its regression test file are byte-for-byte unchanged from the first parent; this update adds the upstream history available at that point.

Integration validation on Linux x64 / Node 24.22.1, after installing the locked dependencies:

- All **117/117** tests across the focused suites above pass.
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:unused-exports`, `npm run check:test-import-graph` and `git diff --check` pass.
- The published tree `1af4d299ce5c3b9a097f25850cb2c7c6243a9598` exactly matches the locally tested tree.

The integration commit triggered [hosted CI run 43377348655](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/actions/runs/43377348655); its result is available there. Complete hosted CI and real-model E2E are not claimed as passed by these local integration checks.

## Follow-up for the canonical-pointer CI regression

Retained the additional canonical-pointer fix in `b8545db19c86260036cd4e486fdf29f8ade6be13`. The same argument-spread failure also affected incremental-lane pointer upkeep; that change replaces the unbounded `Math.max(...ptrs)` call with a two-argument reduction.

[Run 43393897505](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/actions/runs/43393897505) exposed a fixture error on Ubuntu / Node 22, Ubuntu / Node 24 and Windows / Node 22: the repository preload selects legacy storage, so the new test's `setSessionExt` call failed before exercising pointer upkeep. The fixture now explicitly selects full unified storage, restores the previous mode afterward, and closes the SQLite handle before removing its temporary directory. No production code was changed by this follow-up.

Published [`5e1972e52e49d7cf79a66d282f33efa609cf6c91`](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/commit/5e1972e52e49d7cf79a66d282f33efa609cf6c91), preserving `b8545db1` as the first parent and integrating upstream master `99c22d283f2fbadb3dc428980dfdc5adc5fcd277` as the second parent. The tested and published tree is `37cdd1bd5f0a2ad4239997568e1aa78b77768b2d`.

Validation on this tree:

- Reproduced the original fixture failure locally with the same storage preload used in CI.
- **150/150** focused reconciliation, canonical-pointer and adjacent incremental-lane tests pass on Linux / Node 24.22.1 with the repository preloads.
- **5/5** long-history and canonical-pointer tests pass on Linux / Node 22.23.4 with the same preloads.
- Temporarily restoring the original `Math.max(...ptrs)` expression makes the repaired regression test fail on the argument-limit assertion; the production fix was restored afterward.
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:unused-exports`, `npm run check:test-import-graph` and the net diff whitespace check pass.

[Hosted CORE CI run 43396508736](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/actions/runs/43396508736) completed successfully on this head: all **27 executed jobs passed**. The canonical-pointer regression passed on Ubuntu / Node 22, Ubuntu / Node 24 and Windows / Node 22. Its tested merge tree exactly matches the published tree above. FULL CI and real-model E2E remain gated as described below.

## Review status

Linked to #6490 and ready for maintainer review. The latest integration validation includes upstream master `99c22d283f2fbadb3dc428980dfdc5adc5fcd277`, as recorded above. Current hosted results are available in the [Checks tab](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/6492/checks).

Please apply the existing `ci:full` label to run the FULL matrix, including the required Windows / Node 24 checks. The default CORE matrix does not produce those checks.

## Additional public-handler coverage

The complementary regression from #6658 is now retained here in commit `04f998bbfdf02d7ed31f40ee5028e5a257e8939e`. It drives `handleIncrementalTurn` with 250,000 restored pointers, places the maximum pointer before the end of the list, and verifies both the incremental query frontier and the appended persisted tail. The existing two-argument reduction passes it without a production change.

The canonical-pointer handler suite and the original #6490 real-storage regression pass **5/5** on this combined head. `git diff --check` passes. This follow-up changes only the test file; hosted CI for the new head is pending.

#6658 duplicates the pointer production fix already present here and is being closed. Its additional coverage is preserved rather than counted as a separate improvement.

pr.title: [PR] fix: honor Request cancellation in the inline engine
pr.author: Afloat16
pr.body:
Closes #6503

## Problem

Inline dispatch accepts a Request object but observes only init.signal. A caller using new Request(url, { signal }) can cancel before response headers or during streaming, yet the inline engine continues forwarding work and the caller's body read remains pending. A pre-aborted Request is also sent upstream.

## Changes

Resolve the effective signal from Request when init.signal is omitted or undefined. Preserve explicit replacement signals and null overrides. Check cancellation before and after request conversion, then reuse the existing pre-header rejection and post-header stream/transport cancellation path.

## Original feature validation

On unchanged master 9674cfafbc78c50245ae0d887483d3d6ce880c15, the new real loopback HTTP suite reports 4 failing regressions and 2 passing override controls. It covers omitted init, undefined init.signal, a committed streaming body, and a pre-aborted Request. Cancellation tests verify the actual upstream connection closes; pre-header errors retain the caller's exact reason.

After completing the build, all 14 tests across inline-request-signal, inline-streaming and pi-inline pass, including existing POST model dispatch, init.signal cancellation, live token delivery and admin/transport integration.

Passed: npm run typecheck; npm run build; npm run check:unused-exports; npm run check:test-import-graph; git diff --check.

The zero-token Codex preflight finds the CLI/distribution but its local model endpoint is unreachable; its real-model case is skipped. Full real-model E2E and upstream CI remain unverified. Request body conversion keeps the existing eager-buffering behavior; this change does not make a pending request-body read interruptible.

## Prior work and submission

Checked 61 author PRs, 166 fork heads, complete inline-engine history, and Request.signal/inline/abort PR and issue searches. The cancellation introduced with #3284 observes init.signal only; no prior change was found for inheritance from a Request.

## Current master integration

Merged upstream `fcc2e848486cc2152e36b6658c517fbfa51ec428` into this branch without rewriting the existing feature commit. Integration head: `1c6d2c5cee73c3bd951c224be4a342098a291e7f`. The merge parents are the original feature head `9bcd9c44488c9225da46e57e86eb81f49f9beddc` and the upstream commit above.

The production file and feature test are byte-for-byte unchanged from the original feature head. Relative to current master, this PR still changes only `src/inline-engine.ts` and `tests/inline-request-signal.test.ts`.

Revalidated the merged tree on Node 24.22.1:

- All 14 tests across `inline-request-signal`, `inline-streaming`, and `pi-inline` pass, using the repository's storage and test-environment preloads.
- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:unused-exports`, and `npm run check:test-import-graph` pass.
- `git diff fcc2e848486cc2152e36b6658c517fbfa51ec428 --check` is clean for this PR's net changes.

The original failure/control reproduction above remains tied to `9674cfafbc78c50245ae0d887483d3d6ce880c15`; the validation in this section was rerun after integrating current master. The dispatch and cancellation cases use loopback HTTP fixtures, and full real-model E2E was not rerun locally. Request-body conversion retains its existing eager buffering and does not make an in-progress body read interruptible.

## Review status

Linked to #6503 and ready for maintainer review. The branch now includes current master and is mergeable; GitHub no longer reports it as behind. [CI run 43377731925](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/actions/runs/43377731925) was queued for this exact integration head when this update was prepared. The [Checks tab](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context/pull/6504/checks) contains the current hosted results.

Please apply the existing `ci:full` label to run the FULL matrix, including the required Windows / Node 24 checks. The default CORE matrix does not produce those checks.

final_integration.author: ranxianglei
final_integration.body:
Supersedes #6723 and #6755 (which was accidentally merged into the batch7-wave7 branch instead of master). Head contains both waves: 14 of Afloat16's single-purpose fixes, each merged in with a real merge commit so every original commit and author is preserved in the first-parent history.

Wave 7:

| #6716 | 2026-11-14_linear-coverage-timestamps | #6715 | compression-receipt coverage times: the covered-id dedupe scanned the array per id (`covered.some`, O(n²) on stamped 20k-message folds) → Map, boundary-ref resolution and "never invent a range" semantics unchanged |
| #6718 | 2026-11-14_frozen-message-whitespace | #6717 | frozen-snapshot message re-parse stripped ALL trailing blank lines from every body (content at the end of a message was silently eaten) and lost the ref marker when a body started with a blank line → only the single separator newline before the next header is removed; leading/trailing blanks survive verbatim |
| #6722 | 2026-11-14_linear-cache-usage-alignment | #6721 | cache-diff usage alignment: each usage sample re-scanned every request from the back (O(samples×requests) on 10k-request logs) → single forward pointer over the two sorted lists, same 50 ms admission boundary and stable ordering |

Wave 8:

| #6725 | 2026-11-14_jsonl-historian-null | #6724 | historian JSONL export crashed on a stored content of literal JSON `null` (`message.text` on a non-object) → non-object rows now stay verbatim in full exports |
| #6727 | 2026-11-14_jsonl-ccr-originals | #6726 | full JSONL export dereferenced CCR placeholders to the indexed ENTRY metadata instead of the stored original bytes → resolve byRef→byHash, disk store fills gaps, corrupt/missing mirror keeps the placeholder |
| #6733 | 2026-11-14_join-message-content | #6732 | message readers decoded content with one content-store lookup PER ROW → metadata query stays separate, bodies fetched in bounded 500-row batches (sqlite JOIN for pointer reads, same on the mysql backend) |
| #6735 | 2026-11-14_keepalive-body-failures | #6734 | keepalive pings swallowed every `resp.text()` error (a 200 with a truncated/gzip-mangled body was treated as a normal miss) → body read errors now use the fail-streak budget, 429 keeps first-response disarming, an old response cannot spend the replacement snapshot's budget |
| #6739 | 2026-11-14_keepalive-rotated-timers | #6737 | credential rotation deleted the registry entry but never cancelled the scheduled ping — the dropped snapshot stayed referenced until its old cadence fired → `disarm(..., "credential-rotated")` |
| #6738 | 2026-11-14_cache-diff-insertion-boundaries | #6736 | cache-diff "mid-insert append" misclassified inserting a WHOLE message between existing ones as a semantic append (byte shape is identical) → require same element count with exactly one span growing by the insertion; growth before the root array now reports preArray divergence |
| #6742 | 2026-11-14_usage-log-attribution-tags | #6740 | usage-log parsing attributed samples to the new logger's `[v=]`/`[sess=]` tags (or a request scope) instead of the explicit session → strip logger tags, require the session tag directly before `[acp-usage]`, never invent one |
| #6743 | 2026-11-14_nested-upstream-error-codes | #6741 | upstream alert errno extraction only read the outer `error.code` — native fetch failures nest the errno in `cause` → walk the cause chain (depth-capped, cycle-safe), outer nonempty code keeps precedence |
| #6747 | 2026-11-14_linear-fold-registration | #6744 | batch fold registration re-scanned the whole fold list to close open records per block (O(folds×blocks)) → closeFrom cursor; batch/individual parity kept |
| #6748 | 2026-11-14_linear-handoff-capture | #6746 | handoff reply metering re-encapsulated the entire accumulated text on every delta (O(n²)) → incremental byte accounting with surrogate-pair junction correction; exact UTF-8 budget boundaries kept |
| #6750 | 2026-11-14_diagnostics-unicode-bounds | #6749 | diagnostics truncation used plain `slice`, which can split a surrogate pair at the bound → `safePrefix` everywhere the bound applies (log tails, config, conflict detail, topic) |

commits.subject: test: fix generatedAt 1ms flake in cache-fold batch/individual parity test
commits.message:
test: fix generatedAt 1ms flake in cache-fold batch/individual parity test

buildSessionCacheReport stamps generatedAt: Date.now() at build time. The
batch/individual parity test deepEqual'd two reports built 1ms apart, so it
flaked whenever the two builds straddled a millisecond boundary (CI red on
ubuntu 22/1 and windows 22/4: generatedAt ...904 vs ...905). Normalize
generatedAt to 0 before the comparison — it is a generation-time marker, not
part of the ledger/report parity being asserted. All ledger data already
matched; only the wall-clock field differed.

selected.title: fix(server): lock operator generation state transitions
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.full_inventory_search_source: Complete disjoint created-date-partitioned closed-author PR search, merged_at present.
selected.summary_en: Serialize operator retries and cancellations with concurrent generation-state transitions.

selected.technical_value: Re-reads the scoped generation job under the same PostgreSQL row lock used by generation completion, evaluates the transition and updates state within one transaction. Queue operations and audit publication occur after that transaction.

selected.selection_reason: Addresses concurrent state mutation through transactional row-lock discipline, with explicit race-oriented integration fixtures.
selected.review_method: Inspected the exact final merge-commit production and regression-test patches. Test evidence is from committed fixtures, without a fresh execution.

selected.author: Afloat16
selected.full_inventory_search_source: Complete disjoint created-date-partitioned closed-author PR search, merged_at present.

selected.selection_reason: Prevents a destructive ordering error in the restore workflow and validates both refusal and compatible-snapshot controls.
selected.review_method: Inspected the exact final merge-commit production and regression-test patches. Test evidence is from committed fixtures, without a fresh execution.

selected.title: fix(sync): remove replica vectors after remote tombstones
selected.author: Afloat16
selected.full_inventory_search_source: Complete disjoint created-date-partitioned closed-author PR search, merged_at present.

selected.summary_zh: 远端删除提交且同条目的先前写入完成后，清理副本中的向量片段。
selected.technical_value: Captures the replica's local row ID before deleting a tombstoned origin record, dispatches cleanup only after the SQLite transaction commits and orders it after earlier writes for that row. Local and replicated deletions share a serialized cleanup lane.
selected.test_evidence: Committed fixtures cover observations, summaries and prompts, assert the replica row ID and matching document type, delay an earlier write to test ordering, discard cleanup on rollback and verify a simulated vector-service failure preserves durable sync progress and permits later cleanup.
selected.limitations: Vector cleanup is best effort. Failures are logged and durable synchronization continues, so a failed vector-service deletion can leave fragments until a later cleanup. Tests use an in-memory SQLite store and a simulated vector client, and were not rerun.
selected.selection_reason: Fixes stale search fragments caused by replicated deletions while explicitly covering transaction rollback and write/delete ordering.
selected.review_method: Inspected the exact final merge-commit production and regression-test patches. Test evidence is from committed fixtures, without a fresh execution.

selected_project_groups.name: Claude-Mem
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Serialize concurrent generation retries and cancellations, refuse incompatible restore snapshots before replacing live data, and order replica-vector cleanup after committed deletions.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 以行锁协调并发生成任务的重试与取消，在替换现有数据前拒绝不兼容的恢复快照，并在远端删除提交后有序清理副本向量。

selected_project_groups.name: Craft Anything
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Reject incomplete GNU tar metadata before installation writes, bound retained Node SEA metadata, and recover ELF dynamic imports and exports from partial section layouts.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 在安装写入前拒绝不完整的 GNU tar 元数据，限制 Node SEA 元数据保留量，并从节区不完整的 ELF 中恢复动态导入与导出。

selected_project_groups.name: DeepFace
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Preserve exact S3 keys and release response streams, validate FTP endpoints and connection cleanup, and reuse decoded queries for one-shot image inputs.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 保留完整 S3 对象键并释放响应流，校验 FTP 端点与连接清理，并复用已解码图像以支持单次读取的查询输入。

selected_project_groups.name: COLMAP
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Restore Python 3 image collection with bounded retries and response cleanup, and make translation-angle evaluation invariant to reconstruction scale.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 修复 Python 3 图像采集、有限重试与响应资源释放，并让平移夹角评估不受重建尺度影响。

selected_project_groups.name: REA
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Preserve UTF-8 at diagnostic cutoffs, resume complete NDJSON messages after interrupted iteration, and honor cancellation when bounded reads finish.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 保留截断诊断输出中的完整 UTF-8 字符，在迭代中断后继续处理完整 NDJSON 消息，并在有界读取完成时响应取消。

selected_project_groups.name: Sentence Transformers
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Exclude padded tokens before CNN convolution and compute RRF retrieval metrics without inserting unretrieved positives into observed rankings.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 在 CNN 卷积前排除填充 token，并在 RRF 评估中避免将未检索到的正例插入实际排名。

selected_project_groups.name: LeRobot
selected_project_groups.summary_en: Apply V-JEPA 2's pairwise RoPE correction to VLA-JEPA's training-only world predictor.
selected_project_groups.summary_zh: 将 V-JEPA 2 已有的成对 RoPE 修正应用于 VLA-JEPA 的训练期世界预测器。
